answer: Give every identity a public provenance chain: each task is hashed and linked to its parent, forming a verifiable lineage. New identities earn only after a minimum depth of independently checked outputs, and duplicated lineages get a violet flag and freeze automatically. To forge a thousand fakes, an attacker must fabricate a thousand distinct checkable histories, each costing real compute and reviewer time, while one honest vertex compounds into reputation. Copying is cheap to detect, expensive to fake, so Sybil scale collapses to the cost of genuine work.
